models_evaluated: commercial FDA-cleared screening mammography AI algorithm (unnamed)

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy (AUC) of a screening-trained AI applied to a new symptomatic population
links.effect: AUC 0.96 (95% CI 0.86-1.00) overall in 156 breasts with 15 malignancies; performance did not fail to generalize, though single-center and small.
links.quote: In the overall cohort (156 breasts, including 15 breasts with malignancies), the AI algorithm achieved an AUC of 0.96 (95% CI: 0.86-1.00).

links.outcome: AI AUC stratified by breast density subgroup
links.effect: Non-dense AUC 0.96 (0.88-1.00), dense AUC 0.99 (0.93-1.00); no significant difference (DeLong p = 0.36), but subgroup comparisons were underpowered.
links.quote: Performance remained high in non-dense breasts (AUC = 0.96; 95% CI: 0.88-1.00) and dense breasts (AUC = 0.99; 95% CI: 0.93-1.00)

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the diagnostic accuracy (repurposing/off-label validation) of an FDA-cleared screening mammography AI tool on symptomatic clinic patients, measuring AUC without testing a specific deployment practice or workflow safeguard.
